Introduction

Cross Gene was a South Korean boy group that originally debuted on June 11, 2012, under Amuse Korea Entertainment. As of 2025, the group currently consists of three members: Shin, Sangmin, and Yongseok. While Shin remains under Amuse Korea, Sangmin and Yongseok departed the agency on December 31, 2019 following the expiration of their contracts, though both expressed interest in continuing as members of Cross Gene. The group has been on indefinite hiatus, primarily due to the members' mandatory military service, all of which have now been completed.

Over the years, several members of Cross Gene have departed the group for various personal and professional reasons. J.G. was the first to leave in 2013, returning to China following a family matter. In 2017, Casper parted ways with the group, with limited public explanation, though fans speculated health concerns may have played a role. Takuya, the group's Japanese member, left in December 2018 after his contract with Amuse Korea expired, later shifting his focus to acting and modeling. In December 2020, Seyoung announced his departure to pursue a solo music career under the name COiBLEN, and has since remained active in music and content creation.

Shin announced CROSSGENE's disbandment at his BZZA - Back To You Live on the 21st of October 2023. Amuse confirmed on the official crossgene.jp website, annoucing end of service for the website in April 2024. They have since deleted both Cross_Gene and CrossGene_JP Twitter accounts, along with locking the Cross Gene Official Instagram account.
